# assessed event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessedEvent`](gmeow-assessedEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessedEvent>

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md), [`gmeow:ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md), [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`ComplianceAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-ComplianceAssessment.md) to name the single event whose compliance is being judged — the observation's feature of interest.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one event per assessment (it is functional) and avoid naming the norm here (that is [`gmeow:assessedNorm`](gmeow-assessedNorm.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:assessedEvent`](gmeow-assessedEvent.md) once from the assessment to its [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md); it specializes [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) for generic observation queries.
